body: Never move, delete-and-recreate or reuse a published Go module tag. proxy.golang.org and sum.golang.org cache a version forever once any client fetched it, so a re-tag serves old code from the proxy and a 'checksum mismatch - SECURITY ERROR' to direct fetches. To replace a bad release: publish the next patch with `retract vX.Y.Z // reason` in go.mod and optionally delete the GitHub release page (keep the tag). Expect the proxy's @latest to lag up to ~30 min. Explain this before acting when asked to overwrite a release (v0.2.0 case, 2026-09-25).
